item.title: Another Year Gone, Freelance Going Nowhere? The Clock Shop
item.description: December is close and the year feels wasted. A quiet scene in a clock shop about slow progress you can't see, and a calmer way to start 2027.

item.title: API Returning Stack Traces in Production? The Kiosk Queue
item.description: A screenshot of your API's error page lands in a client's message at 8:50 on a Monday. Is the stack trace showing too much? A calm story and a way forward.

item.title: CSV Commas Shifting Columns? The Changing Room Bench
item.description: A comma in an address field and suddenly every column is off by one. A calm story about messy CSV imports, and what a quiet Monday looks like without them.

item.title: CSV File Keeps Breaking My Import? The Tide Table
item.description: The import rejects your CSV for the fourth time and the client launch is at noon. A calm story about breaking out of the fix-and-retry loop.

item.title: Materials Markup Too High? The Call Over a Cold Flask
item.description: The customer says your materials markup is too high and your tea goes cold. A quiet story about answering calmly, and knowing your real margin.

item.title: Didn't Track Business Expenses All Year? The Hill Walk
item.description: November, a hill walk, and the thought you've dodged since March: you never tracked your expenses. A calm story about starting late, with no shame.

item.title: Freelance Business a Mess? The Map at the Info Desk
item.description: Your freelance business feels like a mess and you don't know where to start. A short story about a holiday that isn't one, and a map that says: you are here.

item.title: Quoted Too Cheap, Materials Eating Profit? The Pickup Line
item.description: You quoted a garden job from memory and the receipts in the cup holder say the materials ate your profit. A calm story about seeing it before it happens.

item.title: Client Wants a Rush Translation Today? What to Charge
item.description: A same-day translation request lands while you're at the regatta clubhouse, and you freeze on the price. A calm story about charging for rush work.

item.title: Worried About 2027 Freelance Income? The Lease Renewal
item.description: The lease renewal letter asks one simple question: can you commit to next year? A calm story for freelancers whose income is unpredictable.

item.title: API Key Visible in Frontend Code? The Tasting Table Text
item.description: A message from a client's nephew, a key in the browser, and a knot in your stomach. A calm story for anyone asking whether an exposed API key is trouble.

item.title: API Returns Too Much Data? The Window Envelope Call
item.description: A screen-share, a network tab, and one JSON field nobody meant to send. A calm story for developers who worry their API says more than it should.

item.title: Client Missed the Payment Run? The Hallway Paint Roller
item.description: Your client missed the payment run and the invoice is still open. A story about the knot in your stomach, and a calmer way to follow up.

item.title: CSV Decimal Comma Won't Add Up in Excel? The Balcony Sum
item.description: The total says 0, the numbers sit on the left, the report is due at five. A story about decimal commas in a CSV – and getting the afternoon back.

item.title: CSV Junk Header Rows Breaking Import? The Blood Test Queue
item.description: The export has report titles on top and a total line at the bottom, and your import keeps failing. A quiet story about a morning like that, and the way out.

item.title: CSV Messy Dates and Duplicates, Due Today? The 9:05 Text
item.description: A CSV full of mixed dates and duplicates, and the client wants it by five. A short story about the knot in your stomach, and what a calmer Thursday feels like.

item.title: Customer Won't Pay a Materials Deposit? The Utility Room
item.description: The customer says they'll pay when it's done, and the supplier wants cash now. A quiet story for tradespeople stuck funding the materials.

item.title: Excel Shows Dates as 45231 After CSV Import? Breakfast Room
item.description: 7:45 in a hotel breakfast room, the CSV opens and every date is a five-digit number. A calm story about the 45231 problem and the morning after.

item.title: Sent Your First Freelance Invoice? The Gift-Wrap Counter
item.description: You sent your first freelance invoice and now wonder what's missing. A lunchtime story about that wobble, and a calmer way to send the next one.

item.title: Freelance Receipts, What Accountant Needs? The Slipway
item.description: Your accountant asks for 'everything' and you have a shoebox, three inboxes and a phone full of photos. A calm story about finally knowing what goes where.

item.title: Freelancer Quarterly Taxes Panic? The Quiet Coach, 8:40
item.description: A deadline reminder, a half-empty account and no idea how much to set aside. A short story about freelancer quarterly taxes and finding calm.

item.title: How Much Safety Stock Is Enough? The Recital Row
item.description: You sit in a folding chair at a recital, doing stock maths in your head. How much safety stock should a small shop keep? A calmer way to stop guessing.

item.title: How Much to Charge for Handmade Jewelry? The Deli Queue
item.description: A stranger admires your ring and asks the price. You hear yourself say a number you made up. For makers who feel like they're just guessing.

item.title: Checking Your Bank for a Client's Payment? The Bus Tour
item.description: You swipe to your banking app for the ninth time today, waiting for a client's payment. A story about the knot behind the refresh, and a calmer way to wait.

item.title: Busy Salon, Not Sure It Pays? The Baby Shower Question
item.description: Your diary is full, your feet ache, and someone asks if business is booming. You smile, but you honestly don't know. A quiet story for solo stylists.

item.title: Scared to Send a Final Notice? The Kite Hill Sunday
item.description: Draft open, thumb hovering, stomach in a knot. A story for freelancers who feel guilty about sending a final notice for an unpaid invoice.

item.title: Staff Keep Asking the Same Questions? The Third Roundabout
item.description: Your phone buzzes at the roundabout: the same question again. A small business owner's story about answers that live only in your head.

item.title: Three Interviews, Mixing Up Companies? The Visitor Badge
item.description: Three interviews in one week and the companies blur together. A quiet story about the lobby moment you dread, and how it can feel instead.

item.title: Time Blindness and Always Late? Can't Plan Your ADHD Week
item.description: Joining the call eleven minutes late, again? A quiet story about time blindness, ADHD and a week you can finally see on one page.

item.title: Two Recruiters Submitted Me for the Same Job? The Ticket Barrier
item.description: Two recruiters, one role, and your phone buzzing at the station barrier. A calm story about keeping your head clear when your name is in two places.

item.title: No Response After Applying? When to Follow Up: The Jigsaw
item.description: Applied, heard nothing, and the phone stays face down. A quiet story about when to follow up after a job application, and how to stop guessing.

item.title: Backup Ran, Files Are Empty? The Humming Freezer
item.description: The script said it finished. The folder says 0 KB. A calm story about the green tick that lied, and what a backup you can actually trust feels like.

item.title: Client Owes Me Money: Give Up or Take It Further?
item.description: A client owes you money and you're torn between letting it go and pushing on. A skatepark bench, a phone and a calmer way to decide your next step.

item.title: Client Paid Late Again and Wants More Work? The Tile Wall
item.description: A message arrives: 'Can you start phase two?' Invoice one is still unpaid. A quiet story about holding a calm line, without begging.

item.title: Undercut on Handmade Prices? The Kiln Shop Car Park
item.description: Someone is selling a lookalike mug for half your price. Before you slash yours, a quiet story about knowing your real numbers first.

item.title: CORS Wildcard in Production? The Escape Room Countdown
item.description: A wildcard CORS header and a few open endpoints, two days before launch. A calm story about the doubt in the back of your head, and how it can ease.

item.title: CSV Dates Day and Month Swapped? The Corridor Chairs
item.description: You sent the report, then a client asked why you billed a day they were closed. Day and month swapped after a CSV import. A calm story, and a way out.

item.title: Customer Saw Another's Data in Your API? Oat Milk Queue
item.description: A customer saw someone else's data through your API. How did you miss it? A calm story about the message, the fix and what changes after.

item.title: CSV Long IDs Turn to 4.9E+12 in Excel? The Station Bakery
item.description: A 9:30 call, a CSV and order numbers that read 4.9E+12. A short story about long IDs, Excel, and getting your Monday morning back.

item.title: First Quote, No Idea What Markup to Add? The Shelf Bay
item.description: Your first quote, a customer waiting, and no idea what to add on materials. A short story about the pause, and how it can feel calmer.

item.title: Forgot an Appointment Again? ADHD and the Cycle Path
item.description: 10:07 on a cycle path, your phone lights up: the call started seven minutes ago. A story for ADHD brains who forgot an important appointment again.

item.title: Ghosted After the Final Interview? The Charity Shop Queue
item.description: Final interview done, then nothing for eleven days. A quiet story about waiting, checking your phone, and getting your head back when the silence drags on.

item.title: Interview Tomorrow, No Questions to Ask? The Risotto Pan
item.description: Interview tomorrow and your mind goes blank when you think of questions to ask them? A quiet story about the stirring pan, the empty note, and a calmer way.

item.title: Invoice 90 Days Overdue, Client Silent? The Cake Knife
item.description: Your invoice is 90 days overdue and the client has stopped answering. A quiet story about a birthday party, a buzzing phone and a calmer way to chase.

item.title: Junior Dev Built Our API, Safe to Launch? Cake Tasting
item.description: Your junior developer says the API is done and launch is Friday. You're holding a fork of lemon sponge and can't tell whether it's safe. A story about that gap.

item.title: Just Quit to Freelance, Unsure What to Charge? The 12 Bus
item.description: You quit your job to freelance and a client just asked your hourly rate. A bus-ride story about the number you made up, and a calmer way.

item.title: JWT Tokens Never Expire? The Key Box Code
item.description: Standing in a holiday flat, one sentence about a key box code makes you remember: your API's JWT tokens never expire. Is that a problem? A calm story.

item.title: Post-Editing Pay Too Low? The Parents' Evening Corridor
item.description: The agency calls it light post-editing. Your afternoon says otherwise. A quiet story about finding your real hourly pay as a translator.

item.title: Mind Blank in an Interview? The Frozen Smile on Camera
item.description: Your mind went blank in the interview and you couldn't recall a single example of your work. A quiet story about what happens next, and a calmer way to prepare.

item.title: No Rate Limiting on Your API? The Honey Stall Queue
item.description: Launch is Monday and your API has no rate limiting. A Saturday-morning story about the knot in your stomach, and how a calm review can loosen it.
